conventions.convention: Differential entropy is used only when its defining integral is finite; conditional differential entropy is an average of conditional-density entropies, not a formal subtraction of infinities.
The Gaussian channel is real with independent N(0,N) noise, N>0. Rates use natural logarithms in nats/use; separate expected average block-power constraints allow P_j=0.

Gaussian feedback encoders are deterministic Borel maps of their own independent private message and the common output history strictly before the current use; no preshared randomness or message sharing is supplied.

Finite no-feedback MAC messages are independent and uniform, encoders are separate message-only maps, error is average joint message error, and capacity is a closure. Input laws are product conditional on public time sharing.
Physical degradation uses W(y1,y2|x)=W1(y1|x)W2(y2|y1); receiver 1 is stronger.
Finite-DMC feedback is generated by the causal joint law M^{-1} times the product of W(y_i|f_i(m,y^{i-1})); there is no input-cost constraint.
Correlated-source encoders observe their own IID source blocks only; reliability concerns average joint source-block reconstruction error, rather than independent private-message transmission.
The covariance-update correlation is computed after restoring both marginal variances and reversing the sign of the second residual.

load_bearing.statement: For a finite-second-moment real vector X and independent N(0,NI_d) noise, N>0, Y=X+Z has a positive density and finite differential entropy; h(Y_k)≤(1/2)ln(2πe Var(Y_k)), h(Z)≤h(Y)≤Σ_k h(Y_k). With the stated conditional-law assumptions, h(Y|S)≤Σ_k (1/2)ln(2πe[N+E Var(X_k|S)]).

For a uniform finite message M of size m≥2, finite S, conditional observation densities on R^d, and a measurable message-valued estimator with error ε, H(M|Y,S)≤h_b(ε)+ε ln(m−1)≤ln2+ε ln m. For m=1 the conditional entropy is zero.

For the stated centered jointly Gaussian input pair and independent Gaussian noise, the residual after observing Y=a^T X+Z is independent of Y and has covariance K−Kaa^T K/(N+a^T Ka), with the displayed marginal, cross-covariance and opposite-sign normalized correlation formulas.

For P1,P2,N>0, there is a unique ρ_star∈(0,1) solving (1+s1(1−ρ_star²))(1+s2(1−ρ_star²))=1+s1+s2+2ρ_star√(s1s2). The pair ((1/2)ln(1+s1(1−ρ_star²)),(1/2)ln(1+s2(1−ρ_star²))) is achievable under the expected average-power constraints.
For P1,P2,N>0 and every 0<ρ<ρ_star, the feedback channel achieves in closure R1=C(P1(1−ρ²)/N), R2=C((P1+P2+2ρ√(P1P2))/N)−R1; interchanging users gives the opposite dominant corner.

Under the stated finite product-kernel law and a fixed support-restricted typical transmitted tuple, the conditional expected counts of wrong source-indexed typical candidates are bounded by polynomial factors times exp(−n[I1−H(S1|S2)−ω(δ)]), exp(−n[I2−H(S2|S1)−ω(δ)]), and exp(−n[I12−H(S1,S2)−ω(δ)]), with I1=I(X1;Y|X2,S2,Q), I2=I(X2;Y|X1,S1,Q), and I12=I(X1,X2;Y|Q).

For average-joint-error no-feedback independent private-message coding, capacity is the closure of the union over finite Q and P_Q P_{X1|Q} P_{X2|Q} W of R1≤I(X1;Y|X2,Q), R2≤I(X2;Y|X1,Q), R1+R2≤I(X1,X2;Y|Q).
Under the stated independent-private-message no-feedback model, the capacity region consists of nonnegative rates satisfying Rj≤(1/2)ln(1+Pj/N) and R1+R2≤(1/2)ln(1+(P1+P2)/N).
For the stated real AWGN MAC feedback model, capacity is the union over 0≤ρ≤1 of nonnegative pairs satisfying Rj≤(1/2)ln(1+Pj(1−ρ²)/N) and R1+R2≤(1/2)ln(1+(P1+P2+2ρ√(P1P2))/N).

published_dependencies.used_for: Finite entropy and KL conventions in the density-observation Fano lemma and the finite-information prerequisites.
Normalization of the real Gaussian noise density.
The bounded linear change of variables in Gaussian-density normalization, followed by the improper-integral limit.
Positive square-root normalization for N>0 in the Gaussian channel definition.
Normalization of finite product Gaussian densities and integration of Gaussian convolution densities.
